title: Listing withdrawals
intro: Remove only available stock from public sale. Existing bids, purchases, custody and history are preserved.
warning: This stops new purchases. A bid or purchase commitment prevents ordinary withdrawal and requires the exception route.
empty: No published listings in this workspace
unavailable: Current stock is unavailable. No withdrawal is confirmed.
denied: Withdrawal refused — review the current commitment or contact support.
pending: Withdrawal pending. Public availability is held until the original operation is reconciled.
sample: Sample watch content; commands use real stored state.
stale: The listing changed. Reload and review its current version.
